title: Two Smiling Young Women in Summer Shorts, 1950s Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny mid-century black-and-white snapshot showing two smiling young women posing together on a lawn in a residential backyard. They are dressed in typical 1950s casual summer clothing consisting of high-waisted shorts with belts and button-up collared short-sleeve and sleeveless blouses. Dense foliage, a wooden fence, and part of a house roof frame the background, capturing post-war American suburban leisure.
